description: This PHP file defines a class Upgrade13 within the Opencart installation upgrade process, specifically handling database schema updates for upgrade step 13. The class loads language settings, interacts with models and database to add, update, and remove fields related to product identifiers, and generates a JSON response with status or errors.

classes.name: Upgrade13
classes.description: Handles database schema modifications during the upgrade step 13 in the OpenCart installation process, including adding product identifier types and migrating data accordingly.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method executing the upgrade process: loading languages, processing product identifiers, migrating data, and generating JSON output.
